\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 201-204 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R209-first-pass-words-from-chapters-201-204}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to exist and to express.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to book, to spend, to save, to order, to dry
  \item to heat, to cool down, to fill, to empty, to measure
  \item to get divorced, to rest, to wake up, to comb one's hair, to get bored
  \item to burn, to throw away, to calculate, to hit, to compare
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To book? (\textbf{reservar}.) To spend? (\textbf{gastar}.) To save? (\textbf{poupar}.) To order? (\textbf{encomendar}.) To dry? (\textbf{secar}.) To heat? (\textbf{aquecer}.) To cool down? (\textbf{arrefecer}.) To fill? (\textbf{encher}.) To empty? (\textbf{esvaziar}.) To measure? (\textbf{medir}.) To get divorced? (\textbf{divorciar-se}.) To rest? (\textbf{descansar}.) To wake up? (\textbf{acordar}.) To comb one's hair? (\textbf{pentear-se}.) To get bored? (\textbf{aborrecer-se}.) To burn? (\textbf{queimar}.) To throw away? (\textbf{deitar fora}.) To calculate? (\textbf{calcular}.) To hit? (\textbf{bater}.) To compare? (\textbf{comparar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 205-209 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R209-second-pass-words-from-chapters-205-209}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item to steal, to discover, to seem, to serve, to suffer
  \item to come near, to chat, to ring, to deliver, to correct
  \item to give up, to exchange, to download; to unload, to ski, to slip
  \item to disappear, to record, to keep, to exist, to express

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To get worse? (\textbf{piorar}.) To offer; to give as a present? (\textbf{oferecer}.) To observe? (\textbf{observar}.) To take part? (\textbf{participar}.) To go for a walk? (\textbf{passear}.) To steal? (\textbf{roubar}.) To discover? (\textbf{descobrir}.) To seem? (\textbf{parecer}.) To serve? (\textbf{servir}.) To suffer? (\textbf{sofrer}.) To come near? (\textbf{aproximar-se}.) To chat? (\textbf{conversar}.) To ring? (\textbf{ligar}.) To deliver? (\textbf{entregar}.) To correct? (\textbf{corrigir}.) To give up? (\textbf{desistir}.) To exchange? (\textbf{trocar}.) To download; to unload? (\textbf{descarregar}.) To ski? (\textbf{esquiar}.) To slip? (\textbf{escorregar}.) To disappear? (\textbf{desaparecer}.) To record? (\textbf{gravar}.) To keep? (\textbf{manter}.) To exist? (\textbf{existir}.) To express? (\textbf{exprimir}.)
